resolution_note: 640x360 is an interim resolution; a larger-window decision is pending with the owner. Criteria or aspects that depend on fine detail are marked NOT_JUDGEABLE rather than passed or failed.
verdict_reason: The look is not photoreal, not garish and not voxel-like, and in the 40 km poses faceted relief and readable conifer groups approach the primary reference's bottom panel. But across the far/mid range (overview, rome-far, alps-012, alps-out, england-mid, rome-mid, alps-mid) the terrain is a smooth hillshade with no stylised faceting, the palette is dominated by ochre/olive-yellow instead of the reference's moderate fresh green, the reference's light grey-beige faceted mountains are absent (Alps read as white speckle), and at 240/40 km the ground shows magnified texel staircases and streaky stretched slope texture. Rivers in far/mid are uniform thick light-blue lines. These are visible at 640x360 and do not depend on the pending resolution decision. Palette and faceting fail independently of resolution.
hash_check: All 11 PNG sha256 values match manifest.json (recomputed with sha256sum and Python hashlib). All are 640x360; alps-mid, alps-near and rome-near are stored as 8-bit colormap (palette-quantized) PNGs, the others RGB.

criteria.detail: Not overly colourful (meets 'nicht zu bunt'). Sea deep blue is close to the reference. Land, however, is dominated by desaturated ochre/olive-yellow (overview, alps-012, england-mid, rome-mid, rome-near, rome-40km) where the reference's middle/bottom panels show moderate fresh green with lighter grass. Shallow-water zones exist only as a thin pale fringe, not the reference's broad lighter shelves. Note: three frames are palette-quantized, which slightly limits exact colour comparison but not the overall hue judgment.

criteria.judgeable_at_640x360: macro form yes; fine facets at far/mid no
criteria.detail: Far/mid poses (overview, rome-far, alps-012, alps-out, england-mid, rome-mid, alps-mid) and 240 km poses (rome-near, alps-near) show smooth, soft hillshaded relief with no recognisable faceting; the reference's light grey-beige faceted mountain massifs are absent, the Alps read as white snow speckle on dark green. Only alps-40km shows clear triangular facets, but with streaky stretched slope texture and texel staircases inside facets; rome-40km is nearly flat.

rome-near shows Tiber course, three lakes, coast and forest groups (better than the A16 set). But far/mid frames draw every river as a uniform thick light-blue line across the continent (overview, alps-012, alps-out, england-mid, alps-mid), which reads as noise rather than the reference's calm far map; rivers at 240 km are wide flat blue ribbons (alps-near). The 40 km ground (rome-40km lower right, alps-near foreground) is bland ochre with blocky texel staircase patches. Lagoons/meanders/beaches of the reference's bottom panel are not reached (river supplement not on main is a known open item). Whether finer coast/river detail exists below the pixel scale cannot be judged at 640x360.

rome-40km and alps-40km: faceted conifer cones in clearly readable clusters, close to the reference's bottom panel (positive). rome-near/alps-near: small dark clusters readable as groups. rome-mid/alps-mid: forest is dark pixel speckle; whether these resolve into groups at a larger window cannot be judged at 640x360. Far poses: tint only (acceptable for far).
No pose reads as photoreal; stylised materials and tree cones throughout.
Saturation is restrained in all 11 frames; if anything too muted/yellow (see palette).

criteria.judgeable_at_640x360: geometry yes; coast staircases partly NOT_JUDGEABLE
criteria.detail: Geometry is not voxel or block-like. However magnified texel staircases in ground material (rome-40km, alps-near, alps-40km) and stair-stepped raster coasts in overview/alps-012 give a pixelated, blocky surface impression. Part of the coastal staircase may be screen-resolution aliasing, so that part cannot be judged at 640x360; the texel blocks at 40 km span several screen pixels and are real.

criteria.text: keine Terrain-Detailvorgabe aus nachrangigen Bildern; keine Polygon-/Leistungsbehauptung aus Stilbildern
criteria.detail: The manifest compares against STYLE_GUIDE only and makes no polygon-count or performance claim derived from style images.

Poses are fixed and fully bound (lon/lat, zoom, view width, elevation, azimuth, FOV, basis, position, command). But rome-far is not a distinct pose: at zoom 0.0 the camera position_model is identical to overview, and the images differ in only 995 pixels (cloud flecks); Rome is not centred. No side-by-side comparison against the reference panels is provided. Clouds are on and occlude terrain in rome-near, alps-near and alps-mid; no cloud-free control. The far endpoint is a 50-degree oblique, not the flat 2D far map the STYLE_GUIDE requires (scope of another criterion, noted only).
